newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuania blue chips gain as market positive.
newsitem.headline: Lithuania blue chips gain as market positive.

text.p: Blue chip shares dominated Lithuania's bourse on Tuesday as the market closed higher but brokers said key banking shares may slow during the week.
The official list index gained 21.48 points to 1065.15 while the wider group A shares advanced 6.38 points to 1840.29.
Central market turnover was steady at one million litas.
Vilniaus Bank advanced to 280 litas from 275.10 in central market turnover of 69,000 litas and block trades worth 600,000 litas at 300 litas.
Hermis Bank jumped to 265 litas from 255 in heavy turnover of 353,000 litas while it traded 572,000 litas in block deals ranging from 25 to 265 litas.
"For this week, this may be the limit for Vilniaus Bank and Hermis Bank," one dealer said.

Rokishkis Cheese shares showed further signs of strength, advancing to 46 litas from 45.50 in heavy central market turnover of 259,000 litas and block trades worth 166,000 litas at prices ranging from 46 to 46.28 litas.
Brokers say Rokishkis shares are showing a delayed response to solid half-year results and expect it to continue gains in the autumn.
